commit.message: Let customers on legacy plans be invoiced without a plan record

Investigator.investigate.summary: Creating an invoice fails with a TypeError for customers without a plan record. It started at 09:12, 37 times so far.
Investigator.investigate.likely_cause: buildInvoice in src/billing/invoice.ts reads customer.plan.currency, but since 9f2c1ab legacy customers can reach it with no plan.
Investigator.investigate.suspect_commits: - [9f2c1ab](https://github.com/acme/api/commit/9f2c1ab7e4): lets customers without a plan record reach invoicing
Investigator.investigate.first_steps:
- [ ] Fall back to the account's currency when customer.plan is missing
- [ ] Or revert 9f2c1ab
- [ ] Re-run the failed invoices
